title: onochilis tinctoria
intro: Onochilis tinctoria, commonly known as the Amla or Indian Gooseberry, is a deciduous shrub native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. This plant is widely recognized for its rich store of antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, making it a valuable asset in traditional medicine and modern healthcare. The health benefits of Amla include its ability to improve digestion, boost immune function, and support eye health, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic effects. The bioactive constituents of Amla include ascorbic acid, flavonoids, and tannins, which contribute to its potential benefits in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation.
